name: Knee Folds
summary: Lying on the back with knees bent, one knee floats up to tabletop and lowers without the pelvis moving.
steps: Lie on the back, knees bent, feet flat, spine neutral.
Breathe out to float one knee up over the hip, shin level.
Breathe in to lower the foot to the mat.

layers.title: Hold tabletop, then the second leg
Lower one, lift one
layers.text: Legs pass each other in the air.

cautions.note: Not lying flat after the first 12 weeks.

cues:
The thigh bone drops into the hip as the knee lifts.
Belly stays flat, not domed.
No rocking side to side.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Hands on the hip bones to feel for movement
